claim_scores.rationale: Uses two offline DummyLMs, sets `global_lm` via `dspy.configure`, and applies `france_lm` only inside `forward` with `dspy.context`.
Runs the same `CountryProgram` on exactly two inputs, France and Germany, through `dspy.Parallel(num_threads=2)`.
Includes `time.sleep(0.2)` during each call, keeping executions overlapped while the override context is active.
Asserts `answers == ["Paris", "Berlin"]`, showing France used the override LM and Germany used the default LM.
Prints and asserts `dspy.settings.lm is global_lm` after parallel execution, verifying no override leaked back to the main thread.
